review_items.title: Immutable study and evidence binding
review_items.question: Do the supplied hashes, checksum closure, source binding, and package scope correctly bind the exact D0203 author-candidate study without silently substituting different evidence?

review_items.title: Evidence-gap conclusion
review_items.question: Does the bound evidence technically support the author-candidate conclusion that the current immutable evidence is insufficient for a concrete Req06/Req14 accounting-satisfaction determination and that an acquisition specification can nevertheless be defined?

review_items.title: Nonresult and negative-proof boundary
review_items.question: Does the study preserve that current markers such as FORWARD_ACCOUNTING_SATISFIED=NO and REVERSE_ACCOUNTING_SATISFIED=NO mean that satisfaction has not been established or evaluated, rather than constituting negative proof that the requirements are violated or unsatisfied?

review_items.title: Future evidence acquisition specification
review_items.question: Are AEA01-AEA05 sufficient and technically coherent as a future evidence-acquisition specification while remaining only a specification and not actual accounting evidence or mapping?

review_items.title: Forward completeness criteria
review_items.question: Are FC01-FC05 technically adequate to make future Req06 forward-accounting completeness independently recomputable rather than self-proved by the schema forward_complete flag?

review_items.title: Reverse completeness criteria
review_items.question: Are RC01-RC03 technically adequate to make future Req14 reverse-accounting completeness independently recomputable rather than self-proved by the schema reverse_complete flag?

review_items.title: Bidirectional consistency and anti-circularity
review_items.question: Are BC01-BC04 and the anti-circularity rules technically sufficient to require frozen domains, valid identifiers, exact forward/reverse consistency, no dangling references, and no completeness manufactured by circular domain construction?

review_items.title: Accounting versus semantic losslessness
review_items.question: Does the study correctly preserve that even a future successful accounting-satisfaction result would not by itself prove Schema-V2 semantic losslessness or exact semantic reconstruction?

review_items.title: Governance and downstream nonclaims
review_items.question: Are the study boundaries correctly limited so that no actual accounting evidence acquisition, concrete mapping, satisfaction determination, pair reclassification, operational mapping, schema modification, analyzer activity, baseline execution, or repair is authorized or claimed?

review_outcome_semantics.APPROVE_BOUNDED_EVIDENCE_GAP_AND_ACQUISI: Human reviewer accepts the bounded author-candidate study within its stated nonclaims. This does not itself governance-adopt the study and does not authorize actual accounting evidence acquisition.
review_outcome_semantics.REVISION_REQUIRED: Human reviewer does not approve the bounded author-candidate study as supplied. The outcome must be preserved and any correction must use a successor artifact.
